blocks.text: Jeremiah 21 belongs to a book that brings together varied kinds of material, including poetry, prose sermons, narratives, letters, headings, repeated accounts, restoration collections, oracles concerning nations, and an appendix. A practical outline places chapters 2–25 together, but that arrangement does not settle questions about how the book took shape. This broader observation is disputed, so it is best treated as a guide to the book’s varied form rather than a firm explanation of this chapter’s composition.
